METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.

2. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

3. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Forging.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.

4. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

6. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

9. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.

10. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.

11. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.

12. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Gas Welding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Forging and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
